input:
Under heavy MSI-X load from NVMe + network devices, the GIC ITS command queue is overflowing. We see ITS command timeouts and some LPIs are not being delivered. The system has 4 ITS nodes and ~2000 active LPI mappings.

ITS command queue status (from debug registers):
  ITS0 GITS_CREADR: 0x0000FF80
  ITS0 GITS_CWRITER: 0x0000FFA0  (only 32 bytes ahead of reader -- nearly full)
  ITS1 GITS_CREADR: 0x00000100
  ITS1 GITS_CWRITER: 0x00000100  (idle)
  ITS2 GITS_CREADR: 0x00000200
  ITS2 GITS_CWRITER: 0x00000200  (idle)
  ITS3 GITS_CREADR: 0x00000100
  ITS3 GITS_CWRITER: 0x00000100  (idle)

dmesg:
[  180.400] its@2f020000: ITS command queue timeout (MAPTI)
[  180.401] its@2f020000: GITS_CREADR=0x0000FF80 GITS_CWRITER=0x0000FFA0
[  180.402] its@2f020000: retrying command...
[  180.500] nvme 0000:01:00.0: I/O timeout, resetting controller
[  180.501] mlx5_core 0000:02:00.0: missed completion on CQ 12

/proc/interrupts shows ITS0 handling 1800 of 2000 LPIs. The other 3 ITS nodes are barely used. How do we rebalance?
